samples.summary: The canonical pagination doc still describes `resolvePageSetup` as `setup ?? DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP`, but this PR turns it into a validating, clamping read path
samples.evidence: docs-pagination.md:96-97 reads "A helper `resolvePageSetup(setup: PageSetup | undefined): PageSetup` returns `setup ?? DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP`". After this change (packages/docs/src/model/types.ts:826) it substitutes defaults per field for non-finite/negative/zero dimensions, proportionally shrinks margin pairs against a new exported `MIN_CONTENT_PX` floor, and is now the contract both exporters, the DOCX importer and the write-path assert lean on. The new "Page setup UI" section documents only the write-side `RangeError`, not the read-path clamp, so the doc a reader consults for the model contract is now wrong. CONTRIBUTING expects a data-model change to be folded into the canonical subsystem doc rather than only into a new section.

samples.summary: DOCX import's new page-setup validation/clamping is not reflected in the import/export design doc's `<w:sectPr>` mapping
samples.evidence: docs-docx-import-export.md:315-321 still documents `<w:pgSz>`/`<w:pgMar>` as a straight twips→px mapping. The PR adds `sectPrLengthPx` (packages/docs/src/import/docx-parser.ts) which drops non-finite, zero and negative page dimensions (and negative margins) in favour of defaults, and routes the whole parsed setup through `resolvePageSetup`, which can additionally rescale margins. That is a real change to what an imported `.docx` yields and is recorded nowhere in the doc.

samples.summary: Page-setup hardening on the read/import/export paths is scope past the task's stated shape ("pure wiring: no new document behaviour")
samples.evidence: docs/tasks/active/20260829-docs-surface-existing-features-todo.md:3-5 scopes the work as "pure wiring: no new document behaviour, no new file formats, no new model fields", and its plan (steps 1-5) covers only `EditorAPI` exposure plus three frontend surfaces. The write-path assert follows from the new public `setPageSetup`, but the read-path clamp in `resolvePageSetup`, the new `sectPrLengthPx` validation in the DOCX parser (docx-parser.ts:298-347) and routing `PdfExporter`/`DocxExporter` through the resolver serve no acceptance criterion and change import/export output for pre-existing documents. Not harmful, but it enlarges the blast radius of a wiring PR and lands unreviewed behaviour in two exporters and an importer.

samples.summary: A second "Format painter" toolbar toggle is written inline in the docs toolbar instead of joining the shared text-formatting components, duplicating the shipped slides one
samples.evidence: `FormatPainterToggle` (docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx) duplicates the structure of packages/frontend/src/app/slides/toolbar/format-painter.tsx: same `IconBrush`, same `aria-label="Format painter"`, same mount-effect subscription to an editor change listener, same `Toggle` shell. docs/design/slides/slides-toolbar-redesign.md:37-39 states the goal "One source of truth for text formatting controls — both docs and slides import the same components from `packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/`", where `ClearFormattingButton`/`InsertLinkButton` already live. The two painters have deliberately different semantics (two-press vs pointer-mode), so a shared props-driven component was not mandatory — but the tooltip/label/icon and pressed-state contract will now drift in two places.

samples.evidence:
The serializer now folds CR/LF/NEL/U+2028/U+2029 inside a run to a space (`LINE_SEPARATORS` in packages/docs/src/serialize/markdown.ts) — the model's soft line break, produced by DOCX ``, PPTX `` and HTML `

Both change what `wafflebase docs content --format md` emits today, and cli.md:768-770 points users at this table as the exact mapping ("Lossy conversion: see cli.md design for the exact mapping"). samples.summary: The acceptance criterion "the keyboard shortcuts behave exactly as before" is not strictly met — Mod+Shift+C now captures from a different position and drops structural keys
samples.evidence: Acceptance criterion (docs/tasks/active/20260829-docs-surface-existing-features-todo.md:57) says the shortcuts must behave exactly as before. `copyFormat()` now resolves the source through the new `formatSourcePosition()` (selection start / ordered cell rectangle rather than the caret) and `captureFormatAtCursor` strips `image`, `pageNumber` and `href`. Both look like improvements and the todo's review follow-ups record the structural-key strip, but the source-position change is an unrecorded behaviour change to a shipped shortcut, so the criterion as written no longer holds.

samples.summary: Runtime feature-detection (`supportsPainter`) of an in-monorepo `EditorAPI` is defensive scaffolding the workspace dependency should make unnecessary
samples.evidence: `supportsPainter` probes `typeof editor.hasCopiedFormat === "function"` at mount and renders the button disabled if absent, justified by the frontend having no `tsc` and by hypothetical out-of-tree adapters. `@wafflebase/docs` is a `workspace:*` dependency built from this same repo, so the guard (plus the dedicated "editor that predates this PR" test suite) encodes a compatibility surface the repo does not otherwise promise.

samples.summary: Task doc describes a symbol the code does not contain (`NON_PAINTABLE_INLINE_KEYS`)
samples.evidence: The follow-up entry says "`NON_PAINTABLE_INLINE_KEYS` in `text-editor.ts` strips them"; the implementation strips `image`/`pageNumber`/`href` by destructuring inside `captureFormatAtCursor` with no such constant. Harmless drift, but the task record is the trail a later reader follows.
